data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 11.1 million in 2014, representing 3.07% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by specific accounts requiring reserve strengthening, including the emergence of the Talisman claim from an historic year of account, increased notifications on New Zealand earthquake claims from prior years, and problematic developments in the UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account within Healthcare and Professional Indemnity lines. This strengthening offset a profit of GBP 14.2 million recognised on the closure of the 2012 Year of Account.
